app.name: Check Printer & Check Writer
onboarding.title: Print business checks on preprinted stock
onboarding.subtitle: Create exact PDFs, print locally and keep a private check register. No account or bank connection is required.
onboarding.preprinted.title: Preprinted check stock is required
onboarding.preprinted.body: Your stock must already contain the bank identity and MICR routing and account line. This app adds the date, payee, amounts, memo and optional check number.
onboarding.noLetterhead: Ordinary company letterhead is not check stock.
onboarding.noBankConnection: This app does not connect to your bank or move money.
onboarding.country: Where is the bank account held?
onboarding.nextNumber: Next number printed on your physical stock
onboarding.layout: Choose the layout that matches your stock
onboarding.printer: Choose the printer used for this stock
onboarding.calibration.body: Print on plain Letter paper at 100% or Actual size. Place it over your check stock and hold both sheets to a light.
home.newChequeHelp: Create a check, review the exact PDF, then save or print it.
home.pendingOutcome: A print result still needs your confirmation.
cheque.review.title: Review every detail before using check stock
cheque.review.body: The PDF is the authoritative print output. Confirm the number, date, payee, amount, memo, stock position and printer.
cheque.fitError: This text does not fit safely on the selected stock. Shorten the highlighted field.
cheque.numberConfirmation: Confirm that {number} is the next number printed on the physical stock.
output.sampleHelp: Watermarked samples and calibration sheets are always free.
output.noFit: Turn off Fit, Shrink and borderless scaling in the printer dialog.
print.outcome.title: What happened to the physical check?
print.outcome.correctHelp: Record the check as printed and add it to the register.
print.outcome.problem: Paper was marked, but something is wrong
print.outcome.problemHelp: Mark this number as spoiled. A replacement will use the next physical number.
print.outcome.noneHelp: Use this only when Windows confirms the job was cancelled before submission or produced no output.
print.outcome.unknown: If paper may have been marked, choose the problem option and secure or destroy the original.
print.spoiled: Check {number} is recorded as spoiled. Do not use the physical check.
print.notSent: Nothing was printed. The check is ready to try again.
register.empty: Printed checks will appear here automatically.
register.notBalance: These are check totals, not a bank balance.
backup.title: Encrypted backup
backup.body: Choose a backup passphrase that is different from your Windows password. WorksBien cannot recover it.
restore.title: Restore an encrypted backup
restore.warning: Restoring may replace local records. A safety copy will be created first.
restore.confirmNumbers: Before printing again, confirm the next number on each account's physical stock.
restore.freeConservative: A restored backup cannot prove how many free checks were printed afterward. Free printing is therefore unavailable until Lifetime Unlock is restored or purchased.
purchase.title: Lifetime Unlock
purchase.summary: Print unlimited real checks with a one-time purchase. No subscription and no ads.
purchase.freeDisclosure: The first 3 real checks are free. Samples and calibration sheets do not count.
purchase.microsoft: Payment and licensing are handled by Microsoft Store.
purchase.noRenewal: This is not a subscription. It does not renew.
purchase.status.offlineGrace: Lifetime Unlock is available offline. Connect by {date} so Microsoft Store can verify it again.
purchase.status.verificationRequired: Connect to Microsoft Store to verify Lifetime Unlock before starting another real check.
purchase.restore.notFound: No Lifetime Unlock purchase was found for the Microsoft account currently signed in to Store.
purchase.freeLimitReached: You have used the 3 free real checks. Buy Lifetime Unlock to print more.
purchase.priceRequired: Connect once so Microsoft Store can show the current price before a free real check is used.
purchase.verificationRequired: Connect to Microsoft Store to verify the license. Pending print outcomes and existing records remain available.
purchase.cancelled: Purchase cancelled. You were not charged by this app.
purchase.success: Lifetime Unlock is active on this device.
purchase.failed: Microsoft Store could not complete the request. Try again when Store is available.
purchase.bridgeUnavailable: Install and open the Microsoft Store version to buy or restore Lifetime Unlock.
purchase.wrongAccount: Open Microsoft Store with the account that bought Lifetime Unlock, then try Restore purchase again.
privacy.localOnly: Check records stay encrypted on this device unless you export, print or back them up.
privacy.noTracking: No WorksBien account, cloud sync, analytics, telemetry or advertising.
privacy.store: Microsoft processes Store purchases and returns license status and a localized price to the app.
terms.preprinted: For compatible preprinted business check stock only. The app does not print MICR bank information.
terms.noAcceptanceWarranty: Your bank or financial institution decides whether a check is acceptable.
support.diagnosticsHelp: Diagnostics exclude payee names, amounts, bank details and addresses.
error.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero without a currency symbol.
error.unsupportedCharacters: This field contains characters that the check font cannot print safely.
error.printerUnavailable: The selected printer is unavailable. Choose a printer or save the PDF.
error.stockMismatch: The selected stock does not match the calibrated profile.
error.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Your previous data is unchanged.
error.storageDamaged: The local data file could not be verified. Your data was not changed. Restore a verified backup.
error.noSpace: Windows reported insufficient storage. Free space and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Your previous data is unchanged.
state.common.idle.title: Ready
state.common.idle.body: Choose the next action when you are ready.
state.common.loading.title: Working…
state.common.loading.body: Please wait. Do not close the app during this operation.
state.common.empty.title: Nothing here yet
state.common.empty.body: Use the available action to get started.
state.common.warning.title: Review required
state.common.error.title: Could not complete the action
state.common.error.body: Your previous data is unchanged. Try again or open Help.
state.common.success.title: Complete
state.startup.idle.body: Open the app to load your encrypted local records.
state.startup.loading.body: Checking the local data file, single-instance lock and Microsoft Store license.
state.startup.empty.body: No local data file exists yet. Start setup to create one.
state.startup.warning.body: The previous session did not close normally. Review the recovered local data before printing.
state.startup.error.body: The app could not verify its local data or acquire the writer lock. Close another instance or restore a verified backup.
state.startup.success.body: Local records were verified and the app is ready.
state.home.idle.body: Review the account, next physical number and pending print outcomes before creating a check.
state.home.loading.body: Loading the local summary and pending print work.
state.home.empty.body: No account is configured. Add one and calibrate its stock before creating a real check.
state.home.warning.body: A pending print outcome or physical-number confirmation must be resolved before another real check.
state.home.error.body: The summary could not be loaded. Reopen the local file before creating or printing a check.
state.home.success.body: The account and printer profile are ready for the next check.
state.account.idle.body: Choose an account or add the bank jurisdiction, currency and next physical check number.
state.account.empty.body: No account profile exists. Add one without entering routing or online-banking credentials.
state.account.warning.body: The next physical check number has not been confirmed since restore. Compare it with the stock in hand.
state.account.error.body: The account change was not saved. Correct the highlighted field; existing records are unchanged.
state.account.success.body: The account profile and next physical number were saved.
state.printer.idle.body: Choose the Windows printer used for this stock, or select Microsoft Print to PDF for testing.
state.printer.loading.body: Asking Windows for the current printer list.
state.printer.empty.body: Windows reported no available printers. Add a printer or enable Microsoft Print to PDF.
state.printer.warning.body: The selected printer differs from the calibrated printer. Choose the matching profile or recalibrate.
state.printer.error.body: Windows could not open the selected printer. Check its status or save the exact PDF instead.
state.printer.success.body: The selected printer matches this stock profile.
state.calibration.idle.body: Print a ruler sheet on plain Letter paper at 100% / Actual size.
state.calibration.loading.body: Building the exact Letter-size calibration PDF.
state.calibration.empty.body: No calibration exists for this printer and stock. Print a ruler sheet before using real stock.
state.calibration.warning.body: The measured adjustment approaches a protected area. Review the highlighted field before saving.
state.calibration.error.body: The adjustment would leave the page or enter a protected area. Reduce the X or Y offset.
state.calibration.success.body: Calibration was saved for this exact account, printer and stock layout.
state.payee.idle.body: Choose a saved payee or add a new one.
state.payee.loading.body: Searching saved payees on this device.
state.payee.empty.body: No payees are saved. Add the first payee to create a check.
state.payee.warning.body: The payee name may not fit the selected stock. Review the exact preview before continuing.
state.payee.error.body: The payee could not be saved. Remove unsupported or control characters and try again.
state.payee.success.body: The payee was saved locally for future checks.
state.cheque.idle.body: Enter the payee, date, amount and optional memo for the next physical number.
state.cheque.loading.body: Validating the draft against the selected stock and embedded font.
state.cheque.empty.body: No checks match the current view. Create a new check or clear the filters.
state.cheque.warning.body: One or more details need review before this check can become Ready.
state.cheque.error.body: The check cannot be queued. Correct the highlighted field or confirm the physical number.
state.cheque.success.body: The check passed fit and stock validation and is ready for exact output.
state.pdf.idle.body: Choose a folder and file name for the exact Letter-size PDF.
state.pdf.loading.body: Saving the already-verified PDF bytes without changing their layout.
state.pdf.empty.body: No ready PDF exists. Review and queue a check or create a free sample first.
state.pdf.warning.body: A live PDF can produce a negotiable check. Store it securely and verify the destination folder.
state.pdf.error.body: Windows could not save the PDF. Choose a writable folder with enough free space and try again.
state.pdf.success.body: The exact PDF was saved and its integrity hash still matches the queued document.
state.print.idle.body: Load the matching stock, confirm its next position and print at 100% / Actual size.
state.print.loading.body: The durable job is queued. Waiting for the Windows print dialog.
state.print.empty.body: No check is ready to print. Create or select a Ready check first.
state.print.warning.body: The operating system cannot prove whether paper was marked. Choose the conservative outcome if uncertain.
state.print.error.body: The print dialog or printer failed. Report Nothing printed only when Windows confirms no output.
state.print.success.body: The complete document outcome was recorded atomically in the register.
state.register.idle.body: Search or filter checks by account, number, date, payee, amount or status.
state.register.loading.body: Loading the encrypted local check register.
state.register.empty.body: No check records match these filters. Clear the filters or print the first check.
state.register.warning.body: Register totals describe checks only and must not be treated as a bank balance.
state.register.error.body: The register could not be read or exported. Existing records are unchanged.
state.register.success.body: The register selection and totals are current.
state.backup.idle.body: Choose a destination and a separate passphrase for a portable encrypted backup.
state.backup.loading.body: Creating the backup, reopening it and verifying its encrypted contents.
state.backup.empty.body: No verified portable backup has been created from this installation.
state.backup.warning.body: Losing the backup passphrase makes the backup unrecoverable. WorksBien cannot reset it.
state.backup.error.body: The backup failed verification and was not reported as complete. Choose another destination and retry.
state.backup.success.body: The encrypted backup was created and verified at the selected destination.
state.restore.idle.body: Choose a WorksBien encrypted backup and enter its backup passphrase.
state.restore.loading.body: Verifying the backup and creating a safety copy before replacement.
state.restore.empty.body: No backup has been selected. Choose a verified WorksBien backup file.
state.restore.warning.body: After restore, confirm every next physical check number. Free usage is conservatively exhausted.
state.restore.error.body: The backup, passphrase or schema could not be verified. Current local data was not replaced.
state.restore.success.body: The backup was restored. Confirm physical stock numbers before creating another real check.
state.purchase.idle.body: Review the one-time Store price and the permanent features before starting the purchase.
state.purchase.loading.body: Microsoft Store is opening the purchase confirmation. Do not close the app.
state.purchase.empty.body: Microsoft Store did not return the Lifetime add-on. Install the Store-associated package and try again.
state.purchase.warning.body: This is a one-time digital purchase. Microsoft handles payment and refund eligibility.
state.purchase.error.body: The purchase was not confirmed by an active Store license. No Lifetime access was granted.
state.purchase.success.body: Microsoft Store verified the non-expiring Lifetime Unlock.
state.license.idle.body: Use Restore purchase after reinstalling or when Lifetime Unlock is missing.
state.license.loading.body: Checking the signed-in Microsoft Store account for an active durable license.
state.license.empty.body: No active Lifetime license was found for the Store account currently signed in.
state.license.warning.body: The offline verification grace period is ending. Connect to Microsoft Store before its shown date.
state.license.error.body: License verification is unavailable. Existing records and pending print outcomes remain accessible.
state.license.success.body: Lifetime Unlock was verified or restored for the current Store account.
app.dataSaved: Changes save automatically on this device.
dashboard.title: Operations desk
dashboard.subtitle: Prepare, print and reconcile business checks.
dashboard.allReady: Account, stock and printer are ready.
dashboard.notReady: Complete the items below before using live stock.
onboarding.welcomeAction: Set up your first account and stock profile.
onboarding.nextNumber.help: Use the number visible on the next physical check you will load.
onboarding.layout.top: Check on top with two vouchers
onboarding.layout.middle: Check in the middle with two vouchers
onboarding.layout.bottom: Check on the bottom with two vouchers
onboarding.sampleReminder: Use plain paper until the preview and calibration match your stock.
cheque.memo.help: Optional. It appears on the check and voucher.
cheque.category.help: Optional. Used only for local register filtering and exports.
cheque.amount.help: Enter numbers only; currency comes from the selected account.
cheque.date.help: Confirm the date required on the physical check.
cheque.previewUnavailable: Complete the required fields to generate the exact preview.
cheque.duplicateWarning: A similar check already exists. Review it before continuing.
output.title: Choose a safe output
output.actualSizeRequired: Scale must be 100% or Actual size.
output.liveWarning: This live PDF can produce a negotiable check. Verify every detail and store it securely.
output.integrityFailed: The PDF did not pass integrity verification and cannot be printed.
print.awaitingOutcome: Confirm the physical result before creating another live check.
print.destroyOriginal: Secure or destroy any marked original before creating a replacement.
print.outcome.required: Choose the result that matches the physical paper.
register.title: Check register
register.exportHelp: Exported data is no longer protected by the app’s encryption.
payee.title: Payees
payee.name: Payee name
payee.empty: Add a payee now or enter one while creating a check.
payee.import.title: Import payees from CSV
account.title: Accounts
account.name: Account nickname
account.numberPrivacy: Do not enter routing, transit or online-banking credentials.
account.archiveBlocked: Resolve pending print results before archiving this account.
stock.title: Stock profiles
stock.name: Profile name
printer.title: Printer
calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.instructions: Print the ruler sheet on plain Letter paper at 100% or Actual size, then measure the horizontal and vertical difference.
calibration.resetWarning: Resetting removes saved adjustments for this printer and stock profile.
calibration.saved: Calibration saved. Print another plain-paper sample to verify it.
backup.neverCreated: No verified backup has been created.
backup.passphraseHelp: Use at least 12 characters. This passphrase cannot be recovered.
restore.safetyCopy: A local safety copy will be created before restore.
restore.numberReview: Physical-number confirmation is required after restore.
language.title: App language
language.restartNotRequired: The app updates immediately; no restart is required.
privacy.title: Your data stays under your control
privacy.exportWarning: Files you export or print are outside the app’s encrypted storage.
privacy.deleteLocalWarning: This permanently removes local records from this device. It does not delete exported files or backups.
help.title: Printing guide
help.paper: Use compatible preprinted business check stock.
help.scale: Choose 100% or Actual size. Turn off Fit, Shrink and borderless scaling.
help.alignment: Use a plain-paper sample and calibration ruler before loading live stock.
help.micr: The app does not print the MICR bank line or bank identity.
help.pdf: The saved PDF uses the same locked layout as the print output.
confirm.deleteDraft.title: Delete this draft?
confirm.deleteDraft.body: The draft will be removed. Its reserved physical number remains retained when required by the register.
confirm.archivePayee.title: Archive this payee?
confirm.archivePayee.body: The payee will be hidden from new-check suggestions. Existing records are unchanged.
confirm.archiveAccount.title: Archive this account?
confirm.archiveAccount.body: The account will be hidden from new checks. Existing register records are unchanged.
confirm.restore.title: Restore this backup?
confirm.restore.body: Current local records may be replaced after a verified safety copy is created.
confirm.spoiled.title: Mark this check as spoiled?
confirm.spoiled.body: Use this when paper may have been marked. The number cannot be reused; a replacement uses the next physical number.
confirm.deleteLocal.title: Permanently delete local app data?
confirm.deleteLocal.body: This cannot be undone from the app. Create and verify a backup first if you need these records.

error.accountRequired: Choose an account before creating a check.
error.dateBeforeIssue: The cleared date cannot be earlier than the check date.
error.pendingOutcome: Resolve the pending print result before printing another live check.
error.backupTooShort: Use at least 12 characters for the backup passphrase.
